# Vendored `wslc` / `wslc-sys`

Snapshot of [timeroute/wslc-rs](https://github.com/timeroute/wslc-rs) (OpenContainer + logs wrappers)
plus a local patch that exposes `ContainerBuilder::named_volume` /
`named_volume_read_only` via `WslcSetContainerSettingsNamedVolumes`.

Replace with a crates.io release when upstream merges and publishes.
